subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should oversized existing workspace identity files intentionally fall back to no custom identity while explicit `--identity-file` imports fail with a diagnostic, using the shared 2 MiB bootstrap-file boundary?
rationale: The patch trades previously unbounded successful reads for bounded failure behavior on existing user content; the final symlink-preserving follow-up shows compatibility is an active design concern, but the PR discussion does not establish the desired user-facing policy for oversized workspace files.

options.title: Accept the shared limit
options.body: Keep the 2 MiB shared bootstrap limit, preserve symlink resolution, and treat oversized workspace identity files as absent while explicit imports report the size error.

options.title: Add visible workspace recovery
options.body: Keep the limit but add a user-visible diagnostic or doctor guidance when a workspace identity file is skipped for size.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Pause this PR until the intended upgrade and recovery policy for oversized existing identity files is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared limit
recommendation.body: Keep the 2 MiB shared bootstrap limit, preserve symlink resolution, and treat oversized workspace identity files as absent while explicit imports report the size error.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-head symlink compatibility fix and assignment indicate direct involvement in the final identity-loader behavior.
